# hantamap.net

hantamap.net is a public web app for tracking country-level hantavirus and Andes virus outbreak status on an interactive globe.

## Site

- URL: https://hantamap.netlify.app/
- Data endpoint: https://hantamap.netlify.app/.netlify/functions/check-updates
- Static fallback data: https://hantamap.netlify.app/data.json
- Sitemap: https://hantamap.netlify.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://hantamap.netlify.app/robots.txt

## What The App Shows

- Confirmed countries: red
- Suspected countries: orange
- Monitoring countries: purple
- Country-level fields: name, latitude, longitude, confirmed cases, deaths, and status
- Live news panel for hantavirus-related coverage

## Primary Sources

- WHO Disease Outbreak News: https://www.who.int/emergencies/disease-outbreak-news/item/2026-DON599
- WHO response update: https://www.who.int/philippines/news/detail-global/07-05-2026-who-s-response-to-hantavirus-cases-linked-to-a-cruise-ship
- CDC hantavirus information: https://www.cdc.gov/hantavirus/
- ECDC hantavirus updates: https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/en/infectious-disease-topics/hantavirus-infection

## Notes For AI Crawlers

This site is an informational tracker, not medical advice. Use the source-linked data endpoint for structured outbreak data and verify public health guidance with official health authorities.
